# Selection and filters walk cached holders only, never the world.
omni_bl_rebuild_effect = {
    clear_variable_list = omni_bl_holders
    set_variable = { name = omni_bl_visible_count value = 0 }
    set_variable = { name = omni_bl_shown_count value = 0 }
    if = {
        limit = { var:omni_bl_selected = 1 }
        ordered_in_list = {
            variable = omni_bl_cache_blood_of_sea_elves
            order_by = {
                value = 0
                if = {
                    limit = {
                        OR = {
                            AND = { is_female = yes root = { NOT = { has_variable = omni_bl_men_first } } }
                            AND = { is_female = no root = { has_variable = omni_bl_men_first } }
                        }
                    }
                    add = 1
                }
            }
            min = 0
            check_range_bounds = no
            limit = {
                is_alive = yes
                has_trait = blood_of_sea_elves
                omni_bl_matches_filter_trigger = yes
            }
            root = {
                change_variable = { name = omni_bl_visible_count add = 1 }
                if = {
                    limit = {
                        OR = {
                            has_variable = omni_bl_show_all
                            var:omni_bl_shown_count < 40
                        }
                    }
                    add_to_variable_list = { name = omni_bl_holders target = prev }
                    change_variable = { name = omni_bl_shown_count add = 1 }
                }
            }
        }
    }
    if = {
        limit = { var:omni_bl_selected = 2 }
        ordered_in_list = {
            variable = omni_bl_cache_atheus
            order_by = {
                value = 0
                if = {
                    limit = {
                        OR = {
                            AND = { is_female = yes root = { NOT = { has_variable = omni_bl_men_first } } }
                            AND = { is_female = no root = { has_variable = omni_bl_men_first } }
                        }
                    }
                    add = 1
                }
            }
            min = 0
            check_range_bounds = no
            limit = {
                is_alive = yes
                has_trait = atheus
                omni_bl_matches_filter_trigger = yes
            }
            root = {
                change_variable = { name = omni_bl_visible_count add = 1 }
                if = {
                    limit = {
                        OR = {
                            has_variable = omni_bl_show_all
                            var:omni_bl_shown_count < 40
                        }
                    }
                    add_to_variable_list = { name = omni_bl_holders target = prev }
                    change_variable = { name = omni_bl_shown_count add = 1 }
                }
            }
        }
    }
    if = {
        limit = { var:omni_bl_selected = 3 }
        ordered_in_list = {
            variable = omni_bl_cache_cyrogelos
            order_by = {
                value = 0
                if = {

                            AND = { is_female = yes root = { NOT = { has_variable = omni_bl_men_first } } }

                        }
                    }
                    add = 1
                }
            }
            min = 0
            check_range_bounds = no
            limit = {
                is_alive = yes
                has_trait = cyrogelos
                omni_bl_matches_filter_trigger = yes
            }
            root = {
                change_variable = { name = omni_bl_visible_count add = 1 }
                if = {
                    limit = {
                        OR = {
                            has_variable = omni_bl_show_all
                            var:omni_bl_shown_count < 40
                        }
                    }
                    add_to_variable_list = { name = omni_bl_holders target = prev }
                    change_variable = { name = omni_bl_shown_count add = 1 }
                }
            }

            root = {

                if = {

                        OR = {
                            has_variable = omni_bl_show_all
                            var:omni_bl_shown_count < 40
                        }
                    }
                    add_to_variable_list = { name = omni_bl_holders target = prev }
                    change_variable = { name = omni_bl_shown_count add = 1 }
                }
            }
        }
    }
    if = {

        ordered_in_list = {

            order_by = {

                has_trait = blood_of_ranazu

                        }
                    }

                    change_variable = { name = omni_bl_shown_count add = 1 }

                    change_variable = { name = omni_bl_shown_count add = 1 }
                }
            }
        }
